title: Exact Shannon Capacity, Schrijver-Lovasz Collapse, and Characteristic-p Haemers Separations on Polar, Kneser, and Sporadic Strongly Regular Graphs
abstract: We establish three exact algebraic-combinatorial theorems separating the Shannon capacity Theta(G), the characteristic-p Haemers minrank bound minrk_{F_p}(G), the real shifted-adjacency rank, and the semidefinite bounds of Lovasz (theta) and Schrijver (theta') across strongly regular graphs (SRGs) and polar orthogonality graphs. First, via an unconditional primal-dual squeeze using the entrywise non-negative Bose-Mesner matrix B* = (I + (1/(r+1))*A_bar)/n (weight x_2* = 1/(r+1) > 0, inner-distribution contribution a_2* = (n-1-k)/(r+1)), we prove that on every SRG G = srg(n,k,lambda,mu) (r >= 0 > s, with no symmetry assumptions), theta'(G) = theta(G) = 1 + (n-1-k)/(r+1) = -ns/(k-s) identically. On ternary polar SRGs NO_eps(2m+1,3) (m >= 2), this yields a three-way exponential hierarchy: F_3-Gram Haemers matrix M of rank 2m+1 (pinning exact alpha = Theta = minrk_{F_3} = 2m+1 when eps = (-1)^m and an exact F_3-discriminant-parity barrier alpha = 2m < rank_{F_3}(M) = 2m+1 when eps = -(-1)^m), theta' = theta = (3^m + 2 - eps)/2 = Theta(3^m), and real shifted-adjacency rank (3^(2m)+3)/4 or (3^m-1)^2/4 = Theta(9^m/4). Second, for Kneser graphs KG(m,2) (m >= 5) and every prime p, we prove the exact if-and-only-if dichotomy min_{c in F_p^*} rank_{F_p}(cI + A) = m - 1 = Theta(KG(m,2)) iff p | (m-4), and equals m otherwise (with sharp non-collapse at (m,p) = (6,5) despite 5 | (m-1), and universal non-collapse over Q and on the Petersen graph m=5 for every prime p). Third, we prove exponential F_2-Haemers vs. theta' = theta gaps on binary polar complements NO^eps(2m,2)^c for all m >= 4 (2m+1 vs. 2^m - 1 and 2^(m-1) + 2), certify zero-float Sturm primal Schrijver theta' lower bounds on the constant-capacity family NO_{sq/nsq}(3,p) (Theta <= 3 vs. theta' >= 43/13 > 3.30 on NO_nsq(3,17), theta' >= 7/2 on NO_sq(3,19), and exact theta' = theta = 19/5 = 3.8 on NO_sq(3,29)), and construct a zero-float sporadic SRG atlas featuring the Higman-Sims graph srg(100,22,0,6): over F_2, (I+A)^2 = I forces full rank 100, while over every odd prime p >= 3 and Q, rank(A - 2I) = 23 (certified for all p >= 5 by a 23x23 principal minor of det 2^22 * 3^2), pinning 22 <= alpha <= Theta(HS) <= 23 < 80/3 = theta' = theta < 100. All core identities are formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 (20 constructive theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial pytest checks.
